# gravitino_fileset Data Source



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gravitino_fileset" "example" {
  metalake = "example_metalake"
  catalog  = "hive_catalog"
  schema   = "example_schema"
  name     = "ml_datasets"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The catalog name.
- `metalake` (String) The metalake name.
- `name` (String) The fileset name.
- `schema` (String) The schema name.

### Read-Only

- `audit` (Object) Audit information for the fileset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit))
- `comment` (String) The fileset comment.
- `properties` (Map of String) The fileset properties.
- `storage_location` (String) The fileset storage location.
- `type` (String) The fileset type.

<a id="nestedatt--audit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `audit`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String)
- `creator` (String)
- `last_modified_time` (String)
- `last_modifier` (String)
